objective: Choose FCI locations that maximize expected customer-weighted patrol-time savings.

title.en: REL-TASK-051 — FCI placement for patrol-time reduction
title.ru: REL-TASK-051 — Размещение FCI для сокращения времени обхода

objective.en: Select a budgeted set of fault-current-indicator locations to reduce expected customer interruption minutes caused by patrol time.
objective.ru: Выбрать ограниченное бюджетом множество мест установки индикаторов повреждения, чтобы снизить ожидаемые клиент-минуты отключений из-за времени обхода.

instructions.en: Use fci_placement_case. Select exactly budget candidate locations. For each fault section, use the best patrol-time reduction among selected locations, then maximize the annual fault-rate × interrupted-customers weighted saved minutes. Report selected_locations, expected_customer_minutes_saved, and section_patrol_time_reduction_min.
instructions.ru: Используйте fci_placement_case. Выберите ровно budget кандидатных мест. Для каждого повреждаемого участка используйте максимальное сокращение времени обхода среди выбранных мест, затем максимизируйте годовую величину fault-rate × interrupted-customers × saved minutes. Укажите selected_locations, expected_customer_minutes_saved и section_patrol_time_reduction_min.

public_inputs.calculation_spec: Enumerate candidate sets of size budget. For each fault section, take the maximum section_gain_minutes among selected candidate locations. Objective is sum over sections of annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * selected_gain_minutes.

submission_schema.selected_locations: list of selected FCI location IDs
submission_schema.section_patrol_time_reduction_min: object mapping section ID to selected patrol-time reduction

hard_constraints: Selected locations must be the optimal budgeted set under the public objective.
Expected customer-minutes saved and per-section reductions must match the independent calculation.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether submitted FCI placement satisfies all hard constraints.
